scope: Static public-release logs, source bytes and export identities; no candidate execution or API.

original_archive_request_measurement.scope: Original archived request messages before publication privacy rewriting. This is an archival measurement, not a claim that rewritten public requests have identical byte sizes.
original_archive_request_measurement.serialization: len(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False).encode(UTF-8)); default JSON separators; excludes a network transport envelope.

current_exported_request_measurements.interpretation: Calculated from this public export, after privacy rewriting. Equality to original measurements is not required and is not a general invariant.

interpretation: Events overlap. Context and tool errors also occur in accepted attempts. No intervention or causal performance effect is estimated.
